key_structural_ingredients.definition: Contrastive vision-language encoder pre-trained with sigmoid loss for semantic feature extraction
Vector-quantized image tokenizer that converts images to discrete tokens from a learned codebook
key_structural_ingredients.deviation: None - standard VQ-GAN tokenizer with 16384 codebook

key_structural_ingredients.definition: 2-layer MLP with GELU activation mapping visual features to LLM embedding space
Llama-2 style decoder-only Transformer with GQA, RMSNorm, SwiGLU
key_structural_ingredients.deviation: Added QK-Norm from Chameleon for mixed-modal stability

key_structural_ingredients.definition: Progressive training: encoder pre-training -> alignment -> joint fine-tuning -> instruction tuning
key_structural_ingredients.deviation: Extended from LLaVA's 2-stage to 4-stage for dual-encoder alignment

key_structural_ingredients.definition: Special tokens to route inputs through appropriate encoder pathway

distinguishing_features_vs_alternatives.vs_Chameleon: Decoupled encoders instead of single VQ tokenizer for all modalities
distinguishing_features_vs_alternatives.vs_LLaVA: Adds generation capability through VQ-GAN encoder while maintaining understanding
distinguishing_features_vs_alternatives.vs_LlamaGen: Adds understanding capability through SigLIP encoder while maintaining generation
